pla-01.prompt: Flat two-dimensional educational illustration. Simple closed shapes, clear dark outlines, completely solid uniform fills. No gradients, shading or texture. Two complete adults standing shoulder to shoulder facing the viewer, BOTH pointing one hand to their own chest, other arms gently around each other's shoulder. One thin red oval around both as a single group, WE / US. Flat uniform fills dark outlines, whole figures and oval, no labels. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background. Show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. Zoom OUT, leave one sixth of canvas width empty at both sides, generous white above and below. Natural anatomically correct hands. Plain shoes and clothing. No border. Absolutely no text, writing, letters, numbers, labels, brand marks, emblems, logos or watermarks anywhere.

alt.es: Dos personas se señalan el pecho, rodeadas juntas en rojo.
